round: V34: lossy encodings for a smaller web download, native strength check
reference: shipped V31 (float32 base, float16 residuals): its 2048 games on seeds 31300001-31302048 are training/web-release/v31-check/games/q-*.jsonl (check 1)
encodings: training/v34-lossy/quantize.py: base16 (float16 per-stage power-of-two scale; max abs error 29.2), palette (8-bit codes, code 0 exact zero, 255 k-means levels per residual; relative squared error 1.9e-2 / 3.1e-2 / 2.4e-2 for stages 1/2/3). A log-domain palette was tried and dropped before any game (2-4x larger error).
prefilter: 320 V25 browser states, native website search: directions differing from the shipped model: C1 0, C2 12, C3 12 (descriptive)

C1.what: four-cell tables float16 (power-of-two scale per stage) + shipped float16 residuals

C2.what: shipped float32 four-cell tables + 8-bit palette residuals

games: website search (5-ply, cutoff 0.01, clamp, complete depth), standard openings to 12288 or death, training/v31-stages/bin/game, 8 processes per arm via lq
comparison: paired by seed vs the shipped model: reach 6144 and 12288 (exact McNemar), final score (paired normal approximation), identical games
acceptance: an arm passes if none of 6144, 12288 or score is significantly worse (p<0.05 with a negative difference) AND the 6144 difference is at least -1.0 pp. The smallest passing download is chosen; web support for its format is written only then.
